_about: What Registry Stack needs that an XStack design does not ask, and what each level of detail requires for it. Read by design-to-handoff (to fill the gaps section) and by later skills that ask only what a level requires. Alpha may take a starter default for anything; a default is less capable, never less safe. 'trust_boundary' gaps must be answered at beta and may not stay defaulted at live.

levels.alpha: Quick proof of concept. Every gap may take the starter default. Synthetic data, demo identity, local runtime.
levels.beta: Pilot with real users. Every trust-boundary gap is answered. Convenience gaps may stay defaulted, each one listed.
levels.live: Production. No trust-boundary gap stays defaulted. Each answer names an owner and a source.

requires.beta: Purpose stated for each use of data
requires.live: Legal basis cited for each use of data

requires.alpha: None, shown in the phase banner

requires.live: Rules for no match and for duplicates

requires.beta: How recent a fact must be
requires.live: Fallback when the source is unavailable

gaps.name: Audit and access for the person

requires.live: The person can see who accessed their data

requires.beta: Real identity provider in a test environment
